Hanno Eco-Tourism Association

Discover nature's subtle changes on Tenranzan as you walk with a knowledgeable guide — things you might miss on an ordinary stroll.

【Fee】¥2,000 per person; ¥1,500 for repeat visitors; ¥4,000 per family (includes guide fee and insurance)

【Capacity】10 people

【Guide】Tsubasa Kojima (Wildlife Division)

【What to bring】Drinking water, rain gear, backpack or hands-free bag (recommended), towel, insect repellent
